name: Raja Nahar Singh
contribution: As ruler of Ballabhgarh, Raja Nahar Singh was associated with the 1857 uprising and was later executed by the British after the rebellion's suppression.
context: North and central India during the anti-colonial uprising of 1857-1859.
impact: His fate shows how the colonial state punished regional rulers linked to the rebellion after British control was reasserted.
highlight: Raja Nahar Singh of Ballabhgarh was executed after being associated with the 1857 rebellion.
seoTitle: Raja Nahar Singh: Ballabhgarh and the 1857 Rebellion
seoDescription: A concise profile of Raja Nahar Singh, Ballabhgarh, and the colonial reprisals that followed the 1857 uprising.
shortAnswer: Raja Nahar Singh was the ruler of Ballabhgarh who was executed by the British after the 1857 rebellion.
